title: Ramsons RNC 100
subtitle: Hydro Extractor (Coaxial-Drive Centrifugal Water Extractor)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The RNC 100 is part of Ramsons' hydro-extractor range (alongside the RDD and RNC 50/200 lines), used to centrifugally spin excess water out of washed garments/linen before drying. Centrifugal water extraction from garments/linen after washing, ahead of tumble drying.
applications: Post-wash dewatering in commercial laundry / garment finishing lines

overviewDescription: Made by Ramsons Garment Finishing Equipment Pvt. Ltd. (Bengaluru, Karnataka, India). The RNC 100 is a 100 kg-capacity coaxial-drive hydro extractor with SG-grade single-frame casting and SS inner basket + outer drum. The inner basket mounts directly on the drive motor (no belt).
